sql: SELECT * FROM marts.fct_firmware_daily WHERE event_date <= DATE '2026-01-07' ORDER BY hardware_model, firmware_version, event_date

SELECT hardware_model, firmware_version, sum(mean_lte_loss_pct*device_days)/sum(device_days) AS w, avg(mean_lte_loss_pct) AS simple FROM marts.fct_firmware_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH dd AS (SELECT device_id, event_date, hardware_model, firmware_version, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE lte_lost)/count(*),2) AS p FROM marts.fct_device_minute WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' GROUP BY ALL) SELECT hardware_model, firmware_version, avg(p), count(*) FROM dd GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT hardware_model, firmware_version, avg(lte_loss_pct), count(lte_loss_pct) FROM marts.fct_device_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH m AS (SELECT hardware_model, sum(mean_lte_loss_pct*device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.0.0')/sum(device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.0.0') AS lte_loss_1_0_0, sum(mean_lte_loss_pct*device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0')/sum(device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0') AS lte_loss_1_1_0 FROM marts.fct_firmware_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' GROUP BY hardware_model) SELECT hardware_model, round(lte_loss_1_0_0,2) AS lte_loss_pct_1_0_0, round(lte_loss_1_1_0,2) AS lte_loss_pct_1_1_0, round(lte_loss_1_1_0 - lte_loss_1_0_0, 2) AS increase_pp FROM m ORDER BY increase_pp DESC LIMIT 1

WITH m AS (SELECT hardware_model, sum(mean_lte_loss_pct*device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.0.0')/sum(device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.0.0') AS lte_loss_1_0_0, sum(mean_lte_loss_pct*device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0')/sum(device_days) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0') AS lte_loss_1_1_0 FROM marts.fct_firmware_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' GROUP BY hardware_model) SELECT hardware_model, round(lte_loss_1_0_0,2) AS lte_loss_pct_1_0_0, round(lte_loss_1_1_0,2) AS lte_loss_pct_1_1_0, round(lte_loss_1_1_0 - lte_loss_1_0_0, 2) AS increase_pp FROM m ORDER BY increase_pp DESC LIMIT 1
